notes.title: Figment 2 - Future Updates and State of the Game
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone! [/b]I can’t believe it’s been a little over two weeks since launch already 

And we’re sitting at a 97% positive rating on Steam, what a surreal feeling. Thank you for playing our little game and taking the time to leave a review for the game, it really means a lot. After 5 years of work on this project, it’s heart-warming to see so many people enjoying it.

[b]Let's chat about some updates, what is to come next, and the general state of the game: [/b]
[list]
[*] Current Issues
[*] Soundtrack Launch
[*] Trading Cards
[*] About Figment 2 
[*] Running the game on Steam Deck[/list]
[h3][b]CURRENT ISSUES[/b][/h3]

We’ve launched [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1085220/view/3716071937639057174]a patch[/url] just last week solving tons of issues. This means you will lose your current progress in the level, but not the whole game. And it’s safe to mention that when fixing things, others break. But let’s see! I'll be on the lookout for any potential problems popping up.

[h3][b]SOUNDTRACK IS IN PRODUCTION[/b][/h3]

Certainly the most common request, aside from bug fixes, is the availabilty of Figment 2’s OST. Niels, our in-house music man (also the Game Director) is cooking it up as we speak. The songs need some mixing and mastering and we’ll be set. Expect an announcement on that soon. 

If you have any requests as to what you'd like to have on the OST let me know! Instrumentals, mixes, etc.

[h3][b]TRADING CARDS, BADGES, ICONS - NOW AVAILABLE[/b][/h3]

Maybe you've seen them pop up in your inventory already, but we've just added some little trading cards! Featuring some flavor from the game with characters, enemies, pieces of lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/b48f768b0d4478846cdfe5f3393a48bd5877cda6.png[/img]

[h3][b]ABOUT FIGMENT 2[/b][/h3]

The game is no longer on launch period sale. However the bundle makes it pretty cheap if you already own Figment 1. The bundle on the game page makes the game 33% off. Until our next sale that’s a pretty good deal.

Also 97% Positive!!! That’s still crazy to me.

[h3][b]RUNNING ON STEAM DECK[/b][/h3]

Huzzah! The game runs perfecly fine on Deck! And I'm happy to report we haven't heard of any issues. We'll work on getting it officially certified by Valve soon too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/68fcf50a9c267373127a6ec42703e9cd6b8e632f.gif[/img]

[h3][b]PLUSHY COMING SOON[/b][/h3]

...soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/217d7d907b8372606af121dab834e96a1457ad9c.png[/img]

That's all I got for today, thank you for playing Figment 2. If you have any questions about the info above let me know in the comments!

notes.title: Figment 2 - Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
It's been almost 2 weeks since launch, Figment 2 is sitting at a 98% positive rating right here on Steam which is incredible to say the least. However there have been some bugs and issues with the game, in this patch we've tried to address them all. Of course if new things pop up please let me know in the forums or under this post and we'll get right on it.


This patch will clear the [b]current chapter[/b] you are in, but will save your general progress. 

[list]
[*] Limbic Uplands: Fixed softlock where Dusty would get stuck after riding down the snake tail.
[*] Outer Cerebrum: Fixed an issue where plants would not appear during the chase sequence, resulting in a softlock.
[*] Outer Cerebrum: Slightly altered the layout of the level.
[*] Outer Cerebrum: Added a collider to the first Black Hog encounter so you cant run past it.
[*] Outer Cerebrum: Fixed an issue during the last boss battle where the gloom clouds would reappear again immediately, resulting in a softlock.
[*] Conviction Lane: Small change to the island and moving platform near the Opinion on Music puzzle.
[*] Frontal Lobe Plaza: Fixed an issue where the spinner on the moving platform would stop shooting, resulting in a softlock.
[*] Ethics Maze: Fixed an issue where it was possible to collect an engine page twice.
[*] The Moral Compass Core: Fixed some load related issues.
[*] Polished the way that the shard memory menu appears on screen when unlocking memories.
[*] Fixed double shard gathering and percentage not capping to 100%.
[*] Improved the navmesh throughout the game.
[*] Fixed various z-fighting textures.
[*] Fixed an issue where a Shard Stone would glow even though it was empty.
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to save while the death animation was playing, resulting in bugs after load.
[*] Fixed various other small bugs.
[*] Updated Arabic subtitles.
[/list]
A more in-depth post with upcoming plans for the OST, community activities, and general Figment 2 updates will be posted in the following week as well. So stay tuned! 

Thank you again for taking the time to play the game, talk to you soon :)

notes.title: Figment 2: Creed Valley is out NOW!
notes.content:
Well here we are, the day is finally upon us. Figment 2 is now released to you, the players. 

It's been years of ups and downs, self doubt and inhumane motivation - but the game is out! We're incredibly proud of how far Figment has come, we hope you'll have a wonderful time exploring Creed Valley. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085220/Figment_2_Creed_Valley/

[h3][b]Figment 2: Creed Valley offers tons of new features and mechanics[/b][/h3]

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Dusty has gotten better at swinging his sword over the years, he now hits enemies more easily 
[*] Dodge is now directional, meaning you can reposition yourself more easily during combat 
[*] Enemies attach to the beat of the soundtrack, each adding their own musical layer to the fight 
[*] New animations for Dusty and Piper 
[*] Piper is now a controllable character in local co-op or via Steam Remote Play (!!!)[/list]
Quality of Life:
[list]
[*] Chapter Selection Screen is available, if you want to resume specific levels or play specific fights 
[*] Localization in 17+ languages 
[*] Items are color-coded depending on their use[/list]
Mechanics:
[list]
[*] Switching states of mind allows you to see the universe around you in 2 different ways 
[*] Mind Converters also change NPC dialogue, can open/block puzzles[/list]

On the store page, you can find the "complete the set" bundle. Through which you'll get a heavier discount if you own Figment 1. On top of the initial 15% launch discount

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/31028/Figment_Bundle/

[h3][b]That's it for now! I hope you enjoy your time in Creed Valley [/b][/h3]

I'll leave you with the launch trailer if you haven't seen it yet. Don't hesitate to join us across our socials to come chat or ask questions.

notes.title: Figment 2: Creed Valley is Coming Out February 2023!
notes.content:
[h2]Well everyone, it is finally time. [/h2]

What a feeling it is to say that the game we’ve been working on for the past 4 years will be in your hands in just a couple of months.
We’ve had quite the rocky road, with a pandemic and switching the game from a DLC for Figment 1 to a fully fledged standalone sequel. But this announcement is for real.
Our musical and surreal adventure into the human mind is coming to your eyes and ears very soon. So let’s do a quick run down of Figment 2: Creed Valley.

[h2]Musical Showdowns[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/632971c9db72d10925150ae4b7169c276c4de6d0.gif[/img]

Face nightmares in theatrical boss fights. Each fight has unique mechanics, the bosses sing verses shining light on why they’ve appeared. Dodge and weave as the nightmares taunt you with attacks timed to the beat.

[h2]A Journey Across the Subconcious[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/622d9c66e9b1e8a9c7f2b6d3849f61d416920664.gif[/img]

Conviction Lane is based on the amygdala. Dedicated to our set of morals and memories, and the emotional responses to them. As you dive deeper you’ll make your way into the Ethics maze where the ideas of The Mind face trials. Passing the trial means being cemented into the person’s set of morals.

[h2]A Shifting Narrative[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/7b79650437f808c2f950e97a9a9012fc29983212.gif[/img]

The game features a multi-layered narrative, where not everything is told directly to you, the player. During your adventures, interacting with the world unveils what caused the mind to plunge into darkness. So listen closely to the songs’ lyrics, talk to the opinions (residents of The Mind), and collect remembranes (snippets of memories passed).
Switching between Open-minded and Closed-minded shift the music, environments, dialogue, and NPC behaviour in the world. Use both brawn and brain to move forward and clear the obstacles blocking your path.

[h2]Local co-op[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/534afd4a808c84cd58c025c544a5d2f160d793b2.gif[/img]

We should never have to face our fears alone. Piper is now a controllable character for local co-op! Many of you asked for it in Figment 1, it was about time we added this feature.

We can't thank you enough for your enduring support over the years. Now, we get back to work to get this thing out to the world. See you soon!
- The Bedtime Team

notes.title: A Striking Update! - New Combat and Animations. Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone! I hope this message finds you all in good health.[/h1]

IT. IS. TIME. 

We've been cooking up this update for a while now, working on refining Dusty's combat and interactions with the world. He's also received a brand new set of animations, making him look buttery smooth. Let's dive into the details.

This update can be played right now in the prologue, right below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502260/Figment_2_Creed_Valley__Prologue/

[h2]New Combat System[/h2]

No more whiffs (or less at least), and quicker strikes. 
[list]
[*] Dusty now "homes" onto targets to ensure you hit your target. 
[*] An invisible cone eminating from Dusty is in place, making your attacks hit even if you're not directly facing an enemy.
[*] Combo spin swing now happens after 4 swings.
[*] Overhead strike! Attack right after a dodge roll to do an overhead strike.
[*] The overhead strike can cancel a dodge roll.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/ffc549a5570f9c6321bf27d0f0e1c8c2dbd847dc.gif[/img]


[h2]Shiny & Smooth Animations [/h2]

Here's a list of the new animations included in this update.
[list]
[*] Picking up objects.
[*] Kicking interaction.
[*] Overhead swing.
[*] Walking and Running animations. With and without holding the sword.
[*] Knockback when Dusty is damaged.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/718224b0e68fe8ca2d7d338303f306f81987377e.gif[/img]


[h2]Extra Time[/h2]

Oh! I have another gift for those of you who have enjoyed the Jester's Challenge. We've added an extra minute, meaning you should have plenty of time reaching him at the end of the level. And at this imgur link below, you will find a helpful technique to shave off some time. Some of you may already know this but it doesn't hurt to share! 
 - sneaky link: [url=https://imgur.com/a/UC6dkc8]https://imgur.com/a/UC6dkc8[/url]

[h2]So, that's all for now! [/h2]

All this goodness is available in the Figment 2 Prologue!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502260/Figment_2_Creed_Valley__Prologue/

Come chat and hang out in the Bedtime Discord. We'd love to have you alongside us! Click on the image below to check it out :)

[url=discord.gg/bedtimedg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35154628/772c4e019482ff744f21d1e633292e525de98369.png[/img][/url]


See you around, don't hesitate to shoot us questions if you have any in the Steam forums or on the Discord. 

 - Bedtime Hans

notes.title: Figment 2 Prologue Update Out Now!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey hey wonderful people! [/b][/h2]

Well, we've been quite busy with Figment 2 these past weeks since the prologue's release back in January. But, good news! We've got some updates that come straight from the oven. Sit back, relax and get ready to play.

Let's jump right into it: 

[h3][b]5 Extra Minutes have been added! [/b][/h3]

You may have tried the previous iteration of The Jester's Challenge, and we've seen some of you get pretty far! The main obstacle being some of the puzzles. So we're giving y'all 5 extra minutes to rack your brain and see what lies beyond!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/0198c7485e1882ea3cf1f28cfa4d09d989b4ba0e.png[/img]

[h3][b]The Fan Bois have been given less power [/b][/h3]

They now fly lower and are easier to hit! We've taken the decision to make them more of a "cannon-fodder" type enemy. That doesn't mean that they're easy to take care of! Try your best to not get overwhelmed by them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/af7100d62ff89e7f25b06e93ffecc91ea78ebf0d.png[/img]

[h3][b]Slight Cosmetic Changes [/b][/h3]

Opinion were a bit hard to differentiate so we're giving them a little do-over! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/666c8e666700b901ac87fe6606e30c5e9a7efd2a.png[/img]
left: A slightly older opinion, right: the opinion on work.

[h3][b]Dusty's Combat Roll[/b][/h3]

This is the beginning of the multiple combat updates to come! During Dusty's dodge, you'll be able to shift to the left or right, making the combat experience smoother. Try it out and let us know what you think. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39458820/039b80dedf251b42ad79894f922dba2e51ab54eb.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Play it here:[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1502260/Figment_2_Creed_Valley__Prologue/

Well that's all we have for now! Come hang out in our Discord! We've got a lovely community ready to welcome you with open arms. Or just come lurk and check out what we've been up to, you decide :) 
[url=discord.gg/figment]discord.gg/figment[/url]


Oh and by the way, one of the images above has a hint to something we've hidden in The Jester's Challenge. Happy hunting!

notes.title: Update 1 - New in-game element
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/j38ntyYSE9DPGg5zLK/giphy.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Hej hej everyone![/b][/h1] 

[b]We're back with a small update, this time with a new in-game element to Figment: Creed Valley. Drum roll please...[/b]

[h1][b]It's a piano bridge![/b][/h1]
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/PjITWcPhI2M9ZgW1VG/giphy.gif[/img]
Above is a piano bridge in [b]two different states[/b], which changes after you hit the [b]Mind Converter[/b]! The 'switch' lets you adventure through two state of mind, open-minded and closed-minded. Let's get into the design process.

[h1]So the rules were the following:[/h1]
[olist]
    [*]A bridge was needed that would open and close when a switch was hit. It is one of the many puzzle elements in the game who's purpose is to either allow or block access after hitting a switch (open-minded and closed-minded) when navigating through the level.

    [*]A musical environmental element to add character to the world. In the first opus, Figment, the world is living and the main character Dusty is part of it, not the other way around. We felt that the world would feel barren and lifeless without a well-structured landscape.
[/olist]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/k2waCsz.png[/img]

Below is an in-game example of the bridge when open. What is important to note in the [b]open-minded[/b] state is that it is the moment you let the creative juices flow. Here, you see Dusty stepping on a key. The Mind is open to new ideas and in this case, to new music.

In the [b]closed-minded[/b] state, speakers block your path and the piano plays it's own music. The Mind is set in its ways and plays the same tune over and over.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B4yPmTJ.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/x7jZDbQ.png[/img]

If you have any questions on what you've read or seen in this post, comment on the post or @ us on Twitter @Bedtimedg! 

[b]Don't forget to wishlist to stay updated and discover new additions to the game: [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085220/Figment_Creed_Valley/?beta=0
